first.briefTitle: Quaratusugene Ozeplasmid (Reqorsa) and Osimertinib in Patients With Advanced Lung Cancer Who Progressed on Osimertinib

metChecks.headline: Requires an EGFR alteration: chart: EGFR exon 19 deletion.
metChecks.quote: The NSCLC must be epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutation positive-positive based on results from most recent tissue biopsy or most recent evaluation of circulating tumor

metChecks.headline: Requires stage IIIA, IIIB, IIIC, IV, IVA, or IVB: chart shows stage IV.
metChecks.quote: Stage III or IV NSCLC or recurrent NSCLC that is not potentially curable by radiotherapy or surgery.

metChecks.headline: Requires ECOG 0 or 1: chart shows ECOG 1.
metChecks.quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) score from 0 to 1.

metChecks.headline: ANC ≥ 1500/µL: chart shows 3200/µL.
metChecks.quote: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) >1500/mm3, platelet count >100,000/mm3 within ≤28 days.

metChecks.headline: Platelets ≥ 100000/µL: chart shows 210000/µL.
metChecks.quote: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) >1500/mm3, platelet count >100,000/mm3 within ≤28 days.

metChecks.headline: Creatinine ≤ 1.5 mg/dL: chart shows 0.9 mg/dL.
metChecks.quote: Adequate renal function documented by serum creatinine of ≤1.5 mg/dL or calculated creatinine clearance >50 ml/min within ≤28 days.

metChecks.headline: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN: chart shows 0.6 mg/dL.
